en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town in a narrow valley. In the foreground are dense clusters of masonry houses and industrial buildings with steep gabled roofs and small rectangular windows, plus a tall brick chimney. A church or chapel with a modest spire stands among the houses. In the middle and background, detached villas and larger houses dot a wooded hillside, with fields and trees covering the slopes. Forested hills rise on both sides of the valley under an empty sky. No printed caption or visible handwriting appears on the image.
